mechanics.title: Rain growth bonus
mechanics.description: While raining, each supported crop has a 1-in-X chance per tick to grow an extra step. X is configurable, optionally per crop, with a separate speed for stem crops (melon/pumpkin). Setting a crop's speed to 0 disables the boost for it.

getting_started: Plant crops outdoors; they grow faster during rain.
editor_notes: Default speed values not in facts; the pack does not override this mod's config. Whether sky exposure is required is unknown.
name: Crops Love Rain
summary: Crops get extra growth ticks while it is raining. Affects soil-based crops (wheat, carrots, etc.), bamboo, saplings and sugar cane.
